blocks.content: Open Metrics Drilldown to find a metric in your own data.
Open Metrics Drilldown to explore the metrics in your selected data source without writing PromQL.
blocks.tooltip: Start with the metrics already available in your data source.

blocks.content: You are ready to narrow the available metrics to one you want to investigate.
Find a metric by name, compare its label values, and look at related metrics without losing your place.
Enter part of a metric name you can see in your data, then confirm that matching metrics remain in the list. Choose the search term yourself so the results fit your investigation.
blocks.tooltip: Enter part of a name from your own data and check that matching results remain.

blocks.content: Click **Select** on one matching metric and wait for its automatic visualization to appear. Note the metric name and look at the plotted values: you now have a starting point without writing a query.
blocks.tooltip: Choose one matching result and wait until its automatic visualization appears.

blocks.content: Open **By label** and choose a label present on your metric. Inspect the panels for its values to compare how the same metric behaves across those groups; choose the label yourself because the available labels come from your data.
blocks.tooltip: Choose a label from your data and compare the panels for its values.

blocks.content: Open **Related metrics** and inspect the metrics offered alongside your current selection. Look for a name you might investigate next, but keep your current metric selected so you can return to the same investigation.
blocks.tooltip: Inspect the suggestions for your next investigation while keeping your current metric selected.

blocks.content: Return to **Breakdown** and compare the metric name with the one you selected earlier. Confirm you are still investigating that metric and can see the breakdown for your chosen label.
blocks.tooltip: Return to your investigation and confirm the metric and chosen label are still the ones you selected.

blocks.content: You have found a metric with its automatic visualization, compared its label values, and returned from related metrics to the same metric’s breakdown.
